newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank sets 7-day repo at unchanged 5.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank sets 7-day repo at unchanged 5.25 pct.

text.p: Sweden's Riksbank on Tuesday set a new seven-day reverse repurchase money market tender at an unchanged fixed rate of 5.25 percent as expected by the financial markets.
The repo rate, the central bank's key monetary policy tool, was last lowered on August 27 to 5.25 percent from 5.40 percent.
This was the 18th cut of the year. The repo rate started the year at 8.91 percent.
The deposit and lending rates, which form the floor and ceiling of the Riksbank's interest rate corridor, are currently set at 4.75 percent and 6.25 percent, respectively.
